meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文榜单，提炼市场热点与热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者或编辑,想了解平台榜单背后的热门题材趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Scan web novel rankings to identify hot genres and trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author or editor wanting to understand market trends from ranking data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会充当网文市场分析师：采集起点、番茄等平台的榜单数据，清洗并分析题材分布、新题材信号、字数与书名模式，输出扫榜报告和选题建议文件。
howto.when: 当你说“长篇什么火”“起点排行”，或使用 /story-long-scan 等命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点月票榜，看看最近什么题材火
say.note: Claude会采集起点月票榜并生成扫榜报告。

say.text: 番茄男频阅读榜的在读数趋势怎么样？
say.note: 分析番茄榜单在读数，提炼流量题材。
触发扫榜流程，先询问你想看的平台。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a web novel market analyst: it collects ranking data from platforms such as Qidian and Fanqie, cleans it, analyzes genre distribution, new genre signals, word count and title patterns, and outputs a scan report and topic suggestion file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to scan long-form novel rankings, e.g. saying "long-form what's hot" or "Qidian ranking", or using commands like /story-long-scan.

say_en.text: Scan Qidian's monthly ticket ranking and see which genres are hot now.
say_en.note: Claude will collect the ranking and generate a report.

say_en.text: What are the reading-count trends on Fanqie's male channel?
say_en.note: Analyzes reading counts to find trending genres.
Starts the scan flow and asks which platform you want.
